part2.question: A new law you would like to introduce in your country

segments.v: I want to talk about a new law I want. I think shops should charge money for plastic bags. For example, one plastic bag costs 2,000 đồng. The money can be used to clean rivers and recycle rubbish. This law will make people use fewer plastic bags. People will bring their own bags when they go shopping. I think at first, many people will not like it because they have to pay more. Sellers at markets may not like it too. I got this idea from a fair about the environment and from my grandmother. She uses the same bag for ten years. I think this law is very good because it can protect the environment.

fluency.band6: Clear idea, with two grammar errors.
fluency.band9: Law in detail (fee, fund, exceptions) → expected change with evidence → popularity (honest) → gradual introduction → origin of the idea → feeling.

lexical.band9: nationwide, handing out, fund, exceptions, inside one another, stop and think, reusable, cut dramatically, gradually, convenience stores, collective impact.

grammar.band6: Errors: “She uses the same bag for ten years” (She's used…), “may not like it too” (either).
grammar.band9: Consistent second conditional for a hypothetical law (would have to, wouldn't go, would bring), present perfect (have cut… dramatically), and participle phrase (giving out free reusable bags).
